title: Pagination cursor payloads, version 1
description: Opaque cursor tokens are unpadded base64url of the compact JSON payload (keys in the order listed). checksum = lowercase hex SHA-256 of '<domain>\n' + compact JSON of the payload WITHOUT checksum, keys in the same order. Domains: 'workplan-inspect-cursor-v1', 'workplan-resume-cursor-v1'. A cursor is bound to stateHash and options; it is not authority.

x-shiori-errors.undecodable: Invalid workplan inspect cursor; restart without a cursor
x-shiori-errors.mismatch: Stale or option-mismatched workplan inspect cursor; restart from the first page

x-shiori-errors.undecodable: Invalid workplan resume cursor; restart without a cursor
x-shiori-errors.mismatch: Stale or option-mismatched workplan resume cursor; restart from the first page
